_help: Text for the News Coo paper, the wall Wanted Posters and Den Den Mushi calls (package com.onepiecemod.news). world: stories by saga id, picked by the reader's story chapter. anytime: stories for any time; {island}, {pirate}, {marine}, {sea} are filled in. canon: pirates on wall posters when there aren't enough player posters; saga = the first saga (0-5) they appear in. taunts: what a boss says over the Den Den Mushi when you come close (tier1..tier5 are the fallbacks).

romance_dawn: ROGER'S WORDS STILL ECHO: Twenty-two years after the Pirate King's execution, young dreamers keep setting out to sea in search of the One Piece.
CAPTAIN MORGAN'S IRON RULE: Shells Town residents say the Marine captain's new statue grows taller every week. Taxes grow with it.
SEA KING SIGHTED OFF DAWN ISLAND: Fishermen of Foosha Village warn travellers to keep small boats near the shore.
ALVIDA'S FLEET RAIDS MERCHANT SHIPS: The iron-mace pirate claims she is the most beautiful woman in the seas. Few dare to disagree.
east_blue: BUGGY'S CREW TAKES ORANGE TOWN: Citizens flee as the clown pirate fires his famous Buggy Balls at the harbour.
BARATIE CHEF RETURNS TO THE KITCHEN: Red-Leg Zeff's floating restaurant says it will feed anyone who is hungry, even pirates.
ARLONG'S TRIBUTE DUE AGAIN: The Fish-Man pirate demands payment from every village on the Conomi Islands.
LOGUETOWN PREPARES FOR FESTIVAL: The town where Roger was born and died expects pirates by the hundred. Captain Smoker promises none will leave.
KRIEG ARMADA LOST IN THE GRAND LINE: Only one ship of fifty came back. The survivors speak of a man with hawk-like eyes.
REVERSE MOUNTAIN CURRENTS STRONGER THAN EVER: Sailors heading for the Grand Line are told to aim for the very centre.
paradise: DROUGHT IN ALABASTA: Rain has not fallen on the desert kingdom for three years. Many blame King Cobra; some whisper about Dance Powder.
SIR CROCODILE HAILED AS HERO: The Warlord of the Sea is praised for chasing pirates out of Alabasta's ports.
STRANGE SHADOW OVER JAYA: A ship fell from the sky near Mock Town, and the locals now talk of an island in the clouds.
CP9 SEEN AT WATER 7: Shipwrights of Galley-La say government agents have been asking about old blueprints.
THRILLER BARK DRIFTS INTO THE FLORIAN TRIANGLE: Ships that pass the ghost island are found without their shadows.
SABAODY AUCTIONS DRAW CELESTIAL DRAGONS: Rookies with bounties over 100 million gather on the archipelago. The Navy is nervous.
ENIES LOBBY GATES CLOSE: The judicial island never sleeps. Prisoners carried across the Bridge of Hesitation are never seen again.
summit_war: FIRE FIST ACE TO BE EXECUTED: The Marines will publicly execute Portgas D. Ace at Marineford. Whitebeard is expected to answer.
IMPEL DOWN ON HIGH ALERT: Warden Magellan doubles the guard on Level 6 after rumours of a break-in.
BOA HANCOCK REFUSES THE NAVY: The Pirate Empress will not join the war at Marineford, the Kuja say.
THE WAR OF THE BEST: Seven Warlords, three Admirals and the Whitebeard Pirates clash at Marineford. The world holds its breath.
WHITEBEARD HAS FALLEN: The strongest man in the world is dead. Blackbeard now holds the Tremor-Tremor Fruit.
A NEW ERA BEGINS: Pirates flood into the New World. The Navy starts conscripting at every base.
new_world: FISH-MAN ISLAND QUAKES: Hody Jones's New Fish-Man Pirates threaten King Neptune's palace.
PUNK HAZARD QUARANTINED: A poison gas disaster turned the island half fire, half ice. A mad scientist still lives there.
DOFLAMINGO GIVES UP HIS THRONE?: Dressrosa's king steps down, then takes it back the same morning. Officials call it a misprint.
BIG MOM'S TEA PARTY INVITATIONS SENT: Every invitation is a wedding. Every refusal is a war.
WANO'S BORDERS SEALED: The samurai country lets no ship in or out. Kaido of the Beasts rules from Onigashima.
ZOU FOUND RUINED: The island on the elephant's back was attacked by Jack the Drought. The Minks are rebuilding.
REVERIE OPENS IN MARY GEOISE: Kings of fifty nations gather on the Red Line. Revolutionaries are rumoured to be close.
final_saga: BLACKBEARD BUILDS AN ARMY: Hachinosu, the island of pirates, flies the Blackbeard flag. Ten Titanic Captains answer to Teach.
THE WORLD SHAKES: Waves rise across the seas and old islands sink a little lower each week. Scholars blame something buried in the past.
THE ROAD TO LAUGH TALE: Three Road Poneglyphs have been read, says a source. Somebody is close to the One Piece.
EGGHEAD SIGNAL HEARD WORLDWIDE: A voice speaks from every Den Den Mushi at once about a Great Kingdom, then the line goes dead.
void_century: THE EMPTY THRONE IS NOT EMPTY: Guards in Pangaea Castle report footsteps in the throne room at night.
OHARA'S LAST BOOKS FOUND: Scholars say the Void Century cannot stay hidden forever.
THE MOTHER FLAME: Reports of a great light over the Red Line. The Five Elders give no comment.

anytime: MARINE FLEET CROSSES THE {sea}: Twelve warships under Vice Admiral {marine} sailed past {island} this morning.
PIRATES CLASH NEAR {island}: The {pirate} Pirates and a rival crew fought for two days. Both ships were left without masts.
FESTIVAL AT {island}: Townsfolk invite every passing sailor to the harbour for food, music and fireworks.
SEA KING ATTACKS FERRY: Passengers on a ship bound for {island} were saved by a fisherman with a very big harpoon.
BERRY PRICES RISE: Merchants on {island} say a barrel of meat now costs twice what it did last month.
STORM WARNING FOR THE {sea}: Navigators report sudden cyclones. Captains should keep their Log Pose close.
TREASURE FOUND AT {island}: A child digging on the beach uncovered a chest of gold coins. The Navy collected it 'for safe keeping'.
BOUNTY HUNTERS GATHER: Word is that the {pirate} Pirates are worth hunting. Inns on {island} are full.
WORLD GOVERNMENT RAISES REWARDS: Every bounty in the {sea} will be checked again this season.
NEW MARINE BASE AT {island}: Vice Admiral {marine} promises to 'clean up' the nearby waters.

buggy: Hey, you! Yes, you! Bring me that map before I fire a Buggy Ball at your silly face!
Who are you calling a big red nose?! Come here and say it again!
smoker: This is Smoker. I know you're close. You won't leave this island.
Turn yourself in. I'm not in the mood to chase you.
crocodile: Kuhahaha... So the rookie came all this way just to dry up in my desert.
Dreams are for the weak. Come and I'll show you.
enel: Yahahaha! I heard every word you said down there. God hears everything.
You stand on my land. Kneel, or be struck down.
lucci: Cipher Pol Nine. You are on our list now. Justice will find you.
Darkness is justice. Come, and I will show you.
moria: Kishishishi! What a fine shadow you have. I think I'll keep it.
Come closer... my zombies are hungry for a new friend.
magellan: ...This is the Warden. Nobody breaks out of my prison. Nobody breaks in either.
Give me a moment... my stomach... then I'll poison you.
doflamingo: Fufufufu! You've got guts, coming to my kingdom. Let's see how long your strings last.
Only the winners decide what justice is. Come and lose.
katakuri: I already know what you're going to say. Don't bother.
Mama would like your head on the tea table.
queen: Murrrr! Udon's prisoners are rioting, and the rookie behind it is about to catch the Ice Oni!
Kaido-san's party needs a little entertainment. You'll do.
gunko: The Holy Knights have come to Elbaph to judge the giants. Anyone who stands with them will be judged too.
Rules are rules. No ifs, no buts.
shamrock: Elbaph will be judged, and Cerberus is hungry.
My brother chose pirates. I chose the Holy Land. We'll see whose choice was right.
saturn: ...An insect that crawled to Egghead. The Gorosei do not negotiate.
hody: The surface world will drown. Fish-Man Island answers to me now!
Another human in our sea? Bring him to the plaza. I want everyone to watch.
king: The Beasts Pirates do not answer to rookies. Turn around.
Kaido-san is busy. You'll have to burn through me first.
kid: Get out of my way, or I'll crush you with your own ship!
Another 'future Pirate King'? Ha! Come and try.
killer: Fa fa fa... Kid wants your head. I'll bring it to him.
hawkins: The cards were clear. Your chance of surviving today is three percent.
I drew Death for you. It is never wrong.
mihawk: You seek the world's strongest sword? Then come, and be quick about it.
I do not waste my time on weaklings. Prove you are not one.
kizaru: Ooh, scary... a rookie on the line. Shall I come over at the speed of light?
Maa, maa, I'm on my way.
akainu: Absolute Justice. Every pirate will burn, and you are next.
There is no place in this world for scum like you.
fujitora: I cannot see you, but I hear the sea around you. Shall we roll the dice?
The Navy asked me to bring you in. I would prefer you came quietly.
ryokugyu: Hah. Nice island you're standing on. My roots are under it.
I haven't eaten in three years. You look full of life.
aokiji: Ara ara... I'd rather be sleeping. Don't make me freeze you.
Lazy justice. Just leave, and I won't bother.
whitebeard: Gurarara! A brat with spirit. Come and test this old man.
Every man who calls himself a pirate must face me sooner or later.
big_mom: Life or treat?! Bring me a cake or I'll take your life, mamamama!
My children say a rookie is near. How rude to come without sweets.
kaido: Wololo... a fun fight at last? Don't disappoint me like the others.
Strength is everything. Show me yours.
blackbeard: Zehahahaha! People's dreams never end! But yours ends today.
That power you have... I want it. Zehahaha!
imu: ...You have read what was not meant to be read.
...The world belongs to the throne. Your name will be erased.
loki: Elbaph's cursed prince has broken his chains. Giants and pirates alike, stay clear of the great tree.
Thunder over Elbaph again... they say a dragon sleeps in Prince Loki.
xebec: Ha! The world is mine to take. Get out of my way, or join me.
God Valley will burn, and you with it.
tier1: Gacha... Hey, I know you're out there. My crew is waiting for you!
tier2: Gacha... You're the one with the bounty? Come and get beaten, then.
tier3: Gacha... Turn back, rookie. This island belongs to me.
tier4: Gacha... You've caused enough trouble. I'll end it here.
tier5: Gacha... The world is bigger than you think. Come, and learn.
